## Service: store (Store API)

Documentation for store API

### Create Shipping Carrier
POST /store/shipping-carrier
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-carrier
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/create-shipping-carrier | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/create-shipping-carrier.md

The "Create Shipping Carrier" API allows adding a new shipping carrier.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateShippingCarrierDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- name* string (e.g. "FedEx") - Name of the shipping carrier
- callbackUrl* string (e.g. "https://example.com/get-shipping-rates") - The URL endpoint that CRM needs to retrieve shipping rates. This must be a public URL.
- services object[] - An array of available shipping carrier services
  - name* string (e.g. "Priority Mail Express International") - Name of the shipping carrier service
  - value* string (e.g. "PriorityMailExpressInternational") - Value of the shipping carrier service
- allowsMultipleServiceSelection boolean - The seller can choose multiple services while creating shipping rates if this is true.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object - Shipping carrier data
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier
  - callbackUrl* string - The URL endpoint that CRM needs to retrieve shipping rates. This must be a public URL.
  - services object[] - An array of available shipping carrier services
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - allowsMultipleServiceSelection boolean - The seller can choose multiple services while creating shipping rates if this is true.
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - marketplaceAppId* string - The unique identifier for the marketplace app.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Create Shipping Rate
POST /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/create-shipping-rate | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/create-shipping-rate.md

The "Create Shipping Rate" API allows adding a new shipping rate.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingZoneId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the item that needs to be returned

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateShippingRateDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- name* string (e.g. "North zone") - Name of the shipping zone
- description string (e.g. "Ships next day") - Delivery description
- currency* string (e.g. "USD") - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
- amount* number (e.g. 99.99) - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
- conditionType* string (enum: none | price | weight; e.g. "price") - Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing
- minCondition* number (e.g. 99.99) - Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum
- maxCondition* number (e.g. 99.99) - Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum
- isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
- shippingCarrierId* string (e.g. "655b33a82209e60b6adb87a5") - Shipping carrier id
- percentageOfRateFee number (e.g. 10.99) - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
- shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
  - name* string (e.g. "Priority Mail Express International") - Name of the shipping carrier service
  - value* string (e.g. "PriorityMailExpressInternational") - Value of the shipping carrier service

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object - Shipping zone data
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping zone
  - description string - Delivery description
  - currency* string - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
  - amount* number - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
  - conditionType* string (enum: none | price | weight) - Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing
  - minCondition* number - Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum
  - maxCondition* number - Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum
  - isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
  - shippingCarrierId* string - Shipping carrier id
  - percentageOfRateFee number - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
  - shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - shippingZoneId* string - The unique identifier for the shipping zone.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Delete shipping carrier
DELETE /store/shipping-carrier/{shippingCarrierId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-carrier/{shippingCarrierId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/delete-shipping-carrier | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/delete-shipping-carrier.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingCarrierId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the shipping carrier that needs to be returned

Query parameters:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

- totalOrderAmount* number (e.g. 99.99) - The amount of the price. ( min: 0.01 )
- weightAvailable boolean - Flag to pass when the weight is already calculated and should not calculate again
- totalOrderWeight* number (e.g. 10) - Estimated weight of the order calculated from the order creation side in kg(s)
- source* object - Source of the order
  - type* string (enum: funnel | website | invoice | calendar | text2Pay | document_contracts | membership | mobile_app | communities | point_of_sale | manual | form | survey | payment_link | external; e.g. "website") - Source of order
  - subType string (enum: one_step_order_form | two_step_order_form | upsell | tap_to_pay | card_payment | store | contact_view | email_campaign | payments_dashboard | shopify | subscription_view | store_upsell | woocommerce | service | meeting | imported_csv | qr_code; e.g. "store") - Source subtype of order
- products* object[] - An array of price IDs and quantity
  - id* string - id of product
  - qty* number - No of quantities
- couponCode string (e.g. "TEST") - Coupon code

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object[] - Shipping rate data
  - name* string - Name of the shipping zone
  - description string - Delivery description
  - currency* string - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
  - amount* number - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
  - isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
  - shippingCarrierId* string - Shipping carrier id
  - percentageOfRateFee number - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
  - shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - shippingZoneId* string - The unique identifier for the shipping zone.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get Shipping Carrier
GET /store/shipping-carrier/{shippingCarrierId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-carrier/{shippingCarrierId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/get-shipping-carriers | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/get-shipping-carriers.md

The "List Shipping Carrier" API allows to retrieve a paginated list of shipping carrier.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingCarrierId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the shipping carrier that needs to be returned

Query parameters:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object - Shipping carrier data
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier
  - callbackUrl* string - The URL endpoint that CRM needs to retrieve shipping rates. This must be a public URL.
  - services object[] - An array of available shipping carrier services
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - allowsMultipleServiceSelection boolean - The seller can choose multiple services while creating shipping rates if this is true.
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - marketplaceAppId* string - The unique identifier for the marketplace app.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get Shipping Rate
GET /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate/{shippingRateId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate/{shippingRateId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/get-shipping-rates | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/get-shipping-rates.md

The "List Shipping Rate" API allows to retrieve a paginated list of shipping rate.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingZoneId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the shipping zone
- shippingRateId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the shipping rate that needs to be returned

Query parameters:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object - Shipping zone data
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping zone
  - description string - Delivery description
  - currency* string - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
  - amount* number - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
  - conditionType* string (enum: none | price | weight) - Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing
  - minCondition* number - Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum
  - maxCondition* number - Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum
  - isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
  - shippingCarrierId* string - Shipping carrier id
  - percentageOfRateFee number - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
  - shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - shippingZoneId* string - The unique identifier for the shipping zone.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get Shipping Zone
GET /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/get-shipping-zones | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/get-shipping-zones.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingZoneId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the item that needs to be returned

Query parameters:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- withShippingRate boolean - Include shipping rates array

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object - Shipping zone data
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping zone

### List Shipping Carriers
GET /store/shipping-carrier
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-carrier
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/list-shipping-carriers | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/list-shipping-carriers.md

The "List Shipping Carrier" API allows to retrieve a list of shipping carrier.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object[] - An array of items
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier
  - callbackUrl* string - The URL endpoint that CRM needs to retrieve shipping rates. This must be a public URL.
  - services object[] - An array of available shipping carrier services
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - allowsMultipleServiceSelection boolean - The seller can choose multiple services while creating shipping rates if this is true.
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - marketplaceAppId* string - The unique identifier for the marketplace app.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### List Shipping Rates
GET /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/list-shipping-rates | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/list-shipping-rates.md

The "List Shipping Rate" API allows to retrieve a list of shipping rate.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingZoneId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the item that needs to be returned

Query parameters:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- limit number (default: 0; e.g. 20) - The maximum number of items to be included in a single page of results
- offset number (default: 0) - The starting index of the page, indicating the position from which the results should be retrieved.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- total* number - Total number of items
- data* object[] - An array of items
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping zone
  - description string - Delivery description
  - currency* string - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
  - amount* number - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
  - conditionType* string (enum: none | price | weight) - Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing
  - minCondition* number - Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum
  - maxCondition* number - Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum
  - isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
  - shippingCarrierId* string - Shipping carrier id
  - percentageOfRateFee number - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
  - shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - shippingZoneId* string - The unique identifier for the shipping zone.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Shipping Carrier
PUT /store/shipping-carrier/{shippingCarrierId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-carrier/{shippingCarrierId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/update-shipping-carrier | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/update-shipping-carrier.md

The "update Shipping Carrier" API allows update a shipping carrier to the system.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingCarrierId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the shipping carrier that needs to be returned

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateShippingCarrierDto:
- altId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType string (enum: location)
- name string (e.g. "FedEx") - Name of the shipping carrier
- callbackUrl string (e.g. "https://example.com/get-shipping-rates") - The URL endpoint that CRM needs to retrieve shipping rates. This must be a public URL.
- services object[] - An array of available shipping carrier services
  - name* string (e.g. "Priority Mail Express International") - Name of the shipping carrier service
  - value* string (e.g. "PriorityMailExpressInternational") - Value of the shipping carrier service
- allowsMultipleServiceSelection boolean - The seller can choose multiple services while creating shipping rates if this is true.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object - Shipping carrier data
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier
  - callbackUrl* string - The URL endpoint that CRM needs to retrieve shipping rates. This must be a public URL.
  - services object[] - An array of available shipping carrier services
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - allowsMultipleServiceSelection boolean - The seller can choose multiple services while creating shipping rates if this is true.
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - marketplaceAppId* string - The unique identifier for the marketplace app.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Shipping Rate
PUT /store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate/{shippingRateId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/store/shipping-zone/{shippingZoneId}/shipping-rate/{shippingRateId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/update-shipping-rate | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/store/update-shipping-rate.md

The "update Shipping Rate" API allows update a shipping rate to the system.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- shippingZoneId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the shipping zone
- shippingRateId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the shipping rate that needs to be returned

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateShippingRateDto:
- altId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType string (enum: location)
- name string (e.g. "North zone") - Name of the shipping zone
- description string (e.g. "Ships next day") - Delivery description
- currency string (e.g. "USD") - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
- amount number (e.g. 99.99) - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
- conditionType string (enum: none | price | weight; e.g. "price") - Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing
- minCondition number (e.g. 99.99) - Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum
- maxCondition number (e.g. 99.99) - Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum
- isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
- shippingCarrierId string (e.g. "655b33a82209e60b6adb87a5") - Shipping carrier id
- percentageOfRateFee number (e.g. 10.99) - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
- shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
  - name* string (e.g. "Priority Mail Express International") - Name of the shipping carrier service
  - value* string (e.g. "PriorityMailExpressInternational") - Value of the shipping carrier service

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message
- data* object - Shipping zone data
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the shipping zone
  - description string - Delivery description
  - currency* string - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
  - amount* number - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
  - conditionType* string (enum: none | price | weight) - Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing
  - minCondition* number - Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum
  - maxCondition* number - Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum
  - isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
  - shippingCarrierId* string - Shipping carrier id
  - percentageOfRateFee number - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
  - shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
    - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
    - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - shippingZoneId* string - The unique identifier for the shipping zone.
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
  - shippingRates object[] - Array of shipping rates under this shipping zone
    - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
    - altType* string (enum: location)
    - name* string - Name of the shipping zone
    - description string - Delivery description
    - currency* string - The currency of the amount of the rate / handling fee
    - amount* number - The amount of the shipping rate if it is normal rate (0 means free ). Fixed Handling fee if it is a carrier rate (it will add to the carrier rate).
    - conditionType* string (enum: none | price | weight) - Type of condition to provide the conditional pricing
    - minCondition* number - Minimum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no minimum
    - maxCondition* number - Maximum condition for applying this price. set 0 or null if there is no maximum
    - isCarrierRate boolean - is this a carrier rate
    - shippingCarrierId* string - Shipping carrier id
    - percentageOfRateFee number - Percentage of rate fee if it is a carrier rate.
    - shippingCarrierServices object[] - An array of items
      - name* string - Name of the shipping carrier service
      - value* string - Value of the shipping carrier service
    - _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
    - shippingZoneId* string - The unique identifier for the shipping zone.
    - createdAt* string - created at
    - updatedAt* string - updated at
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
